collection.name: Bank App
collection.description: API tests for the Bank App backend (FastAPI + MongoDB)

requests.name: Get All Users
tests: Each item has id, name, email fields

requests.name: Create User
tests: Response body has id, name, email

requests.name: Create Account
tests: Response has id, userId, balance, accountType, createdAt

requests.name: Get Account by ID
tests: Response has id, userId, balance, accountType, createdAt

requests.name: Get User Accounts
tests: Each item has id, userId, balance, accountType, createdAt
All accounts belong to the user

requests.name: Deposit
tests: Response has id, userId, balance, accountType, createdAt

requests.name: Withdraw
tests: Response has id, userId, balance, accountType, createdAt

requests.name: Get Account Transactions
tests: Each transaction has id, accountId, txnType, amount, createdAt
Transaction list has at least 2 entries (deposit + withdrawal)
